definition: The MCP SDKs let you build servers and clients for the Model Context Protocol, the open standard for giving AI assistants tools and data.
details: MCP was introduced by Anthropic in November 2024; the official SDKs are maintained in the modelcontextprotocol GitHub organisation.

explainer.lead: How to install MCP SDK, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.
explainer.createdBy: Anthropic and the Model Context Protocol project.
explainer.inAi: Write a tool once and use it from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code and other MCP-capable assistants.
